title: Taiwan National Organization at UCI
content_html:
The Taiwan National Organization (TNO) at UC Irvine is a student organization founded in 2017 and registered through UCI’s official campus engagement platform, ZotSpot. Known in Chinese as UCI台灣學生會, TNO focuses primarily on serving students from Taiwan, distinguishing it from the Taiwanese American-oriented TAO also active on campus.

According to TNO’s ZotSpot profile, the organization’s stated purposes are providing useful information and services to Taiwanese students and enhancing connections among members to promote Taiwanese culture. The organization maintains a Facebook page under the name “UCI Taiwan 學生會-Tno.1” and lists a contact email in its ZotSpot directory.

As of the time of research, TNO’s ZotSpot page shows no upcoming events and no recent news posts, and the organization has no identified Instagram presence. It remains listed as an active registered campus organization on ZotSpot.
